```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(terra)
library(raster)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

```

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r shoreline}
shoreline <- terra::vect("../osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated/osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated.shp")
```

```{r input meta}
idx_file <- paste0("../outputs/latest/index.csv")
idx <- tryCatch(
  read.csv(idx_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE),
  error = function(e) {
    cat("<h2>Failed to read index.csv</h2>\n")
    cat("<pre>", conditionMessage(e), "</pre>\n", sep="")
    knitr::knit_exit()
  }
)
idx
```

```{r input tracks}
ntracks = dim(idx)[1]
tracksl = lapply(1:ntracks,function(x) {y = vect(paste0("../",idx$gpkg[x]))
                                        y$name = idx$name[x]
                                        y$centre = idx$centre[x]
                                        y})
```

```{r input rasters}
hs0_files = paste0("../outputs/latest/",sprintf("haz_Hs0_%03d.tif",  1:ntracks))

ibs_files = paste0("../outputs/latest/",sprintf("haz_IB_%03d.tif",  1:ntracks))

Hm0l = lapply(hs0_files, function(x) raster::raster(x))
IBsl = lapply(ibs_files, function(x) raster::raster(x))

hs0_files = paste0("../outputs/latest/",sprintf("hs0_tpkHr_%03d.tif",  1:ntracks))

ibs_files = paste0("../outputs/latest/",sprintf("ibs_tpkHr_%03d.tif",  1:ntracks))

Hm0_tpkHrl = lapply(hs0_files, function(x) raster::raster(x))
IBs_tpkHrl = lapply(ibs_files, function(x) raster::raster(x))


```

```{r hs0 plot}

colz = rev(c("#000078","#0000BB","#0000FF","#0C3AFC","#1975FA","#25B0F7","#32EBF5","#73EEE6","#B4F1D7","#F5F5C8",
             "#F5F564","#F5E032","#F6CC00","#F7A300","#F97A00","#FB5100","#FF0000","#DA0006","#B5000D","#910014",
             "#7B003D","#660066","#88008C","#AB00B2","#CD00D8","#F000FF","#CAA6DE","#DBA7DD","#EDA9D2"))#,"#FFABC7") )
ncolz = length(colz)
colzRamp = colorRampPalette(rev(colz))  # function: returns n evenly spaced colours when called like colzRamp(n)

for(i in 1:ntracks){
  tracks = vect(tracksl)
  terra::plot(rast(Hm0l[[i]]),col = colzRamp(30),range = c(0,15),main = paste0(tracksl[[i]]$name[1]," max Hs0 [m]"))
  terra::lines(shoreline,col="grey")
  terra::lines(tracksl[[i]],col = "green",lwd = 3)
}
```

```{r ib plot}
for(i in 1:ntracks){
  tracks = vect(tracksl)
  terra::plot(rast(IBsl[[i]]),col = colzRamp(30),range = c(0,.75),main = paste0(tracksl[[i]]$name[1]," max IB [m]"))
  terra::lines(shoreline,col="grey")
  terra::lines(tracksl[[i]],col = "green",lwd = 3)
}
```


```{r peak Hs0}
for(i in 1:ntracks){
  tracks = vect(tracksl)
  terra::plot(rast(Hm0_tpkHrl[[i]]),col = colzRamp(30),type = "continuous",main = paste0(tracksl[[i]]$name[1]," Time of peak Hs0 from forecast start [hrs]"))
  terra::lines(shoreline,col="grey")
  terra::lines(tracksl[[i]],col = "green",lwd = 3)
}
```


```{r leaflet max}
# Convert vectors to lon/lat and to 'sp' (avoids terra::as.sf)
shoreline_ll <- sf::read_sf("../osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated/osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated.shp")
tracks_ll    <- lapply(tracksl, function(tr) as(terra::project(tr, "EPSG:4326"), "Spatial"))

# Palettes (uses your existing colzRamp)
pal_hs0 <- colorNumeric(palette = colzRamp(256), domain = c(0, 15),   na.color = "transparent")
pal_ib  <- colorNumeric(palette = colzRamp(256), domain = c(0, 0.75), na.color = "transparent")

track_groups <- paste0("Track: ", idx$name)


m <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = shoreline_ll, group = "Shoreline",
    color = "grey", weight = 1, opacity = 0.8, fill = FALSE
  )

# Tick box per track
for (i in seq_len(ntracks)) {
  nm  <- idx$name[i]
  dash <- ifelse(tracks_ll[[i]]$DATASET == "forecast", "6,8", "")
  
  grp <- paste0("Track: ", idx$name[i])

  

  m <- m %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = tracks_ll[[i]],
      group = grp,
      color = "green", weight = 3, opacity = 0.9,dashArray = dash, label = nm,
      popup = HTML(sprintf("<b>%s</b><br/>centre: %s",
                           htmlEscape(nm), htmlEscape(idx$centre[i])))
    )
}

# Tick box per variable (Hs0 / IB)
for (i in seq_len(ntracks)) {
  m <- m %>%
    addRasterImage(Hm0l[[i]], colors = pal_hs0, opacity = 0.6, project = TRUE, group = "Hs0") %>%
    addRasterImage(IBsl[[i]], colors = pal_ib,  opacity = 0.6, project = TRUE, group = "IB")
}

m %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Hs0", "IB", "Shoreline", track_groups),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  hideGroup("IB") %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_hs0, values = c(0, 15),
    title = "Max Hs0 [m]", position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_ib, values = c(0, 0.75),
    title = "Max IB [m]", position = "bottomleft"
  )

```

shoreline_ll <- sf::read_sf("../osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated/osm_land_polygons_simplifyGeom_0point005_areaGT1e6_aggregated.shp")

pal_ib  <- colorNumeric(palette = colzRamp(30), domain = c(-30, 30), na.color = "transparent")

m <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%

    data = shoreline_ll, group = "Shoreline",
    color = "grey", weight = 1, opacity = 0.8, fill = FALSE
  )

# Tick box per track
for (i in seq_len(ntracks)) {

  m <- m %>%
    addPolylines(
      data = tracks_ll[[i]],
      group = grp,
      color = "green", weight = 3, opacity = 0.9,dashArray = dash, label = nm,
      popup = HTML(sprintf("<b>%s</b><br/>centre: %s",

    )
}

# Tick box per variable (Hs0 / IB)
for (i in seq_len(ntracks)) {

    addRasterImage(IBs_tpkHrl[[i]], colors = pal_ib,  opacity = 0.6, project = TRUE, group = "IB")
}

m %>%

    overlayGroups = c("Hs0", "IB", "Shoreline", track_groups),
